description: Temporal typed-value fidelity batch: LISTAGG renders timestamps in Snowflake's output text (space separator and FF3, never java.time's T-form), procedural temporal variables keep their temporal identity through bind substitution - they re-enter SQL as '...'::DATE cast literals, which TYPEOF's strict non-VARIANT rejection proves by naming the TEMPORAL type rather than VARCHAR - and TRUNC over a temporal behaves as DATE_TRUNC with swapped arguments while its numeric overload is unchanged. Converted 1:1 from features/TemporalFidelityBatchTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT LISTAGG(ts, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ts) FROM tfb_ts
